summary: A Dubai real estate broker with a RERA registration shown appears to lose buyers and owners to a thin homepage and spacing glitches.

findings.problem: The page title appears to show broken spacing in the brand name, such as Al and Barq with extra space codes.
findings.cost: A messy name in the browser tab and search results looks careless.
findings.fix: A clean brand name in the title.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to be a short paragraph with no listings, areas or team shown.
findings.cost: Buyers and owners cannot see what you offer or who you are.
findings.fix: Featured listings, areas and team on the homepage.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address, with a footer that says Powered by Create your own unique website.
findings.cost: A builder advert in the footer looks temporary for a brokerage.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a branded footer.

findings.problem: A menu item reads Online Forum, and only a landline and fax appear, with no form or WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Property enquiries in Dubai usually start on WhatsApp.
findings.fix: A clear menu, an enquiry form and WhatsApp.
